主要内容: On August 5, 2016, Medallion Financial Corp purchased 21,587 shares of common stock at $6.31 per share, totaling $136,136, under its Current Stock Repurchase Program. As of August 5, 2016, $24,142,064 remains available for future repurchases. Since the inception of its original stock repurchase program in November 2003, a total of 2,613,125 shares have been repurchased at a cost of $23,319,673, for an average cost of $8.92 per share. The repurchase program was initiated in 2003 and continued until 2016, with the final repurchase occurring on August 8, 2016. The company's CFO, Larry D. Hall, signed the report on behalf of the company.
